data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":{"adopted_commitment_refs":[],"disanalogies":["Pests do not actively defend themselves or build immunity, whereas school rivals can generate counter-warrants.","Poison acts chemically and predictably, whereas criticism relies on semantic alignment and may fail to apply even if heavily weighted."],"overturn_conditions":["If the overall diversity of the school system collapses to a monoculture due to excessive targeting.","If empirical testing shows that rival defenses scale linearly with criticism weight, preventing any retirement."],"shared_structure":["Both involve a finite resource (criticism budget vs poison dosage) distributed over a growing population (rivals vs pests).","In both, distributing the resource too thinly leaves the population entirely unharmed, while concentrating it achieves the elimination threshold for at least some of the population."],"source_memory_refs":["concentrated_poisoning_analogy"],"transfer_claims":["Just as sub-lethal doses of poison fail to reduce pest populations, sub-threshold criticism weights fail to retire rival positions.","Concentrating the criticism resource on specific targets will cause a measurable drop in the rival population, unlike uniform distribution."]},"claim":"The criticism mechanism fails to retire rivals because batch criticism dilutes per-target warrants below the retirement threshold; allocating criticism budget to a winner-takes-all tournament per batch will increase retirement rates.","counterconditions":[{"case":"The targeted rivals might adapt by generating stronger counter-warrants, nullifying the increased criticism weight.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"Reducing attention to non-targeted rivals may allow unchallenged harmful divergence in the broader school population.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"The schools may lack a reliable metric to identify the 'weakest' rival to target, leading to wasted criticism on robust rivals.","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"By pooling the criticism budget onto the weakest rival(s) per batch, the system creates a threshold effect where targeted rivals accumulate enough criticism weight to be retired, rather than distributing attention uniformly across all 60 rivals such that none reach the retirement cutoff.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
